title: Port Charge Guidelines
content: Port handling charges are assessed based on container size and weight. Standard 20ft containers: Rs. 1000. Standard 40ft containers: Rs. 1500. Consolidated cargo: Rs. 500 per shipment.

title: GST Tariff Information
content: GST on customs clearance services is 18%. All charges subject to GST unless specifically exempt. GST calculation: (Base Amount × 18) / 100.

title: Free Days Policy
content: Free storage days: 5 days for port, 7 days for CFS. Extended free days available for exports. Charges apply from day 6 onwards at Rs. 200 per day.

title: Document Requirements
content: Required documents for import clearance: Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Bill of Lading/AWB, Import License (if applicable), Certificate of Origin.
